facts.text: Jon expressed that seeing his students succeed motivates him and that Gina's support means a lot to him.

evidence.quote: Seeing my students succeed motivates me. It's awesome to help them learn and reach their goals. Your support, Gina, means a lot too.
Thanks for being there for me! It's really made a huge difference and it feels great.

facts.text: Gina acknowledged Jon's efforts and expressed that she is glad to be part of his journey.

evidence.quote: That's awesome, Jon! Seeing your students grow and succeed must be really fulfilling. Glad I can be part of this journey!
Glad I could help, Jon! It's nice to be part of something positive.

facts.text: Jon shared a photo of a group of women doing a dance routine, which he described as being after one of the dance classes.

evidence.quote: Here's a photo of us after during one of the dance classes.
